set.body:
Objective:
Implement the first ntab layer over stable Frame rows: typed feature references, exact support descriptors, materialized/external sources, and explicit batched resolution without duplicating Frame scalar or relational machinery.

Scope:
- Frame columns carry stable FeatureId, FeatureRef, ResourceId, selector, missing-source, and provenance descriptors using explicit logical/physical encodings.
- Typed FeatureCol[A,S] binds a Frame field to a ScalaFIM feature payload A and exact support S after runtime validation.
- Initial adapters cover dense volumes, sparse or ROI volumes, surface fields including indexed vertex support, and parcel data with ordered region identity.
- Reuse VolumeSpace, VoxelIndexSet, SurfaceGeometry plus ordered vertex indices, and atlas region identity from their owning modules.
- Shared plans remain descriptions. In-memory resolution is cross-platform; JVM external resolvers delegate to existing owning-module IO.
- Resolution batches selected rows by resource while preserving Frame row identity and order guarantees.

Acceptance:
- Binding rejects missing fields, wrong feature kinds, malformed references, foreign Frame ownership, and incompatible support.
- Support is extracted from owning domain values, never inferred from payload length.
- Materialized and reference-backed fixtures resolve to equivalent values and exact support.
- Missing source policy is explicit and never encoded as NaN or a fake payload.
- Metadata-only Frame filtering, grouping, joining, and counting never resolves feature payloads.
- Shared JVM/Scala.js tests cover the in-memory path; JVM IO tests cover external resolution separately.
- Frame core remains unaware of every ntab and ScalaFIM feature type.
set.title: ntab 1: feature references, exact support, and batched resolution over Frame rows
